optimized_sql:
WITH sales_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_item_sk,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS cnt_quantity,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN promotion ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = promotion.p_promo_sk
    WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'College'
      AND (promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' OR promotion.p_channel_event = 'N')
      AND date_dim.d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_item_sk
)
SELECT item.i_item_id,
       SUM(sales_agg.sum_quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_quantity), 0)::numeric AS agg1,
       SUM(sales_agg.sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_list_price), 0)::numeric AS agg2,
       SUM(sales_agg.sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_coupon_amt), 0)::numeric AS agg3,
       SUM(sales_agg.sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_sales_price), 0)::numeric AS agg4
FROM sales_agg
JOIN item ON sales_agg.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY item.i_item_id
ORDER BY item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
